parameters.query: ALTER TABLE bookings.recurring_rules ALTER COLUMN membership_id DROP NOT NULL;

ALTER TABLE bookings.recurring_rules ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS customer_id UUID REFERENCES bookings.customers(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_recurring_rules_customer ON bookings.recurring_rules(customer_id) WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE bookings.recurring_rules ALTER COLUMN day_of_week DROP NOT NULL;

ALTER TABLE bookings.recurring_rules DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS recurring_rules_frequency_check;
ALTER TABLE bookings.recurring_rules ADD CONSTRAINT recurring_rules_frequency_check CHECK (frequency IN ('daily', 'weekly', 'fortnightly', 'monthly'));
ALTER TABLE bookings.confirmed_bookings ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS series_label TEXT;

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns
   WHERE table_schema = 'bookings' AND table_name = 'recurring_rules'
   AND column_name = 'customer_id') AS has_customer_id,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.tables
   WHERE table_schema = 'bookings' AND table_name = 'recurring_payment_schedule') AS has_payment_schedule,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns
   WHERE table_schema = 'bookings' AND table_name = 'confirmed_bookings'
   AND column_name = 'series_label') AS has_series_label,
  'Migration 007 complete' AS status;
